taskTemplate.name: Send Initial Closing Disclosure
taskTemplate.description: Send initial Closing Disclosure to borrower

subTaskTemplate.name: Enter Plan Code
subTaskTemplate.description: Enter Plan Code – Enter the plan code in the system. Added when the plan code was not entered during Closing Setup or has changed since; the plan code must be correct before the initial Closing Disclosure is issued.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Initial Closing Disclosure – Enter Plan Code

subTaskTemplate.name: Reconcile Appraisal Fee
subTaskTemplate.description: Reconcile Appraisal Fee – Reconcile the appraisal fee in the system. If an appraisal was obtained, enter the appraisal fee and mark it as paid outside of closing if the fee was received prior to closing. Remove the appraisal fee if no appraisal was used. The appraisal fee should be the only fee listed. Added when the appraisal fee has not been reconciled or has changed since Closing Setup.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Initial Closing Disclosure – Reconcile Appraisal Fee

subTaskTemplate.name: Enter Closing Date
subTaskTemplate.description: Enter Closing Date – Enter the confirmed closing date obtained from the branch into the system. Added when the closing date is not yet in the file or has changed; the initial Closing Disclosure cannot be issued against an incorrect closing date.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Initial Closing Disclosure – Enter Closing Date

subTaskTemplate.name: Enter CD Issue Date
subTaskTemplate.description: Enter CD Issue Date – Enter the date the initial Closing Disclosure is issued to the borrower. Added when the CD issue date must be entered or corrected; this date starts the three-business-day waiting period that must elapse before closing.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Initial Closing Disclosure – Enter CD Issue Date

subTaskTemplate.name: Send Initial CD
subTaskTemplate.description: Send Initial CD – This subtask auto-completes when the initial Closing Disclosure is sent to the borrower; do not complete manually.
subTaskTemplate.type: Send Initial Closing Disclosure – Send Initial CD
